What Apple Notification Grouping is — and what your listing may claim

Apple ships Notification Grouping under Settings → Notifications → [App] → Notification Grouping. Buyers choose how notifications from each app stack in Notification Center:

  • Automatic (自动分组) — iOS picks the grouping style per app. Gallery frames may show the Automatic option selected on the grouping sheet.
  • By App (按 App 分组) — all notifications from the app collapse into one stack regardless of thread. Common for productivity and feed apps with many alert types.
  • Off (关闭分组) — notifications appear individually without stacking. Marketing when your app emphasizes every alert visible at a glance.
  • Stacked notification threads (通知堆叠 / 堆叠通知) — screenshot captures showing collapsed thread stacks buyers expand to read individual alerts.
  • Thread vs app grouping contrast — when your English listing honestly pairs conversation-thread stacks with per-app grouping settings. Include thread vocabulary only when your US listing already shows that distinction.

Your gallery may lead with a Notification Grouping settings capture on one frame and a stacked thread demo on the next. zh-Hans caption lines should name the correct surface per frame — a grouping mode picker is not a Scheduled Summary time sheet and not an AI digest summary card.
